europe_now.title: Ursula von der Leyen condemns Ratko Mladić funeral in Serbia
europe_now.summary: European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen has strongly condemned the funeral proceedings for Ratko Mladić in Serbia, labeling the event as shocking. Regional tensions have risen following the public gatherings and subsequent international backlash surrounding the burial.

sources.headline: Ursula von der Leyen condemns ‘shocking’ Ratko Mladić funeral in Serbia

europe_now.title: Russian airstrikes resume against Kyiv
europe_now.summary: Russian military forces have renewed missile strikes on Kyiv resulting in casualties following a brief three-day pause. The escalation comes immediately after diplomatic visits to the Ukrainian capital by United States envoys.

sources.headline: 🔴 Live: At least two killed in Kyiv as Russia renews strikes after three-day pause

top_stories.title: Eiffel Tower Labor Dispute
top_stories.summary: An official investigation was launched after female personnel at the Eiffel Tower were reportedly replaced by men for a religious delegation's visit. The controversy prompted significant public uproar and subsequent labor protests at the Paris landmark.

top_stories.title: French AI Startup Valuation Milestone
top_stories.summary: French artificial intelligence firm Mistral has achieved a valuation exceeding 21 billion euros following its latest major funding round. The substantial capital injection underscores the rapid growth and financial backing of European technology startups.
